title: Newly Established Solar Power Plant Equity Stake For Sale in Besut, Malaysia
tagline: We are building an Off-Grid Solar farm in Besut, East Malaysia, tapping into the sunny skies to power up our community. - This is one of the first Off-Grid Solar projects in the country, making it a trailblazer in the solar industry. - Our solar farm has secured a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) at a premium tariff with a top-notch resort — a win-win for everyone! - Construction is already underway and set to wrap up in 4 to 5 months. Exciting times ahead! - We are expecting to rake in about 3.5 million in revenue each year once we are fully operational. - Our team is small but mighty, comprising just 3 dedicated employees who are passionate about clean energy. - The business holds a valid registration certificate. - Our customers include a luxury resort looking to enhance their green initiatives while reducing energy costs.
